# Innovate with cloud native

Developer freedom starts here. Quickly build, run, and modernize dynamic applications using AI and open source services.

[Try Oracle Cloud Free Tier](/cloud/free/)

[Contact an Oracle cloud native expert](/cloud/cloud-native/contact-us/)

![](/a/ocom/img/yt-video-thumbnail-j94lc3oqgso.jpg)

Cloud Native on OCI: Choose the Right Runtime for Every Workload (1:15)

## Why build cloud native applications on OCI?

*   #### Lowest costs
    
    OCI provides the same—or better—performance to build and run any application at a consistently lower price than all other hyperscalers.
    
*   #### More database options
    
    OCI offers the broadest, most secure database services for enterprise use cases: Oracle AI Database, HeatWave MySQL, NoSQL Database, and many more.
    
*   #### Deploy anywhere
    
    OCI delivers the widest range of cloud options, including sovereign, dedicated, hybrid, and multicloud with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
    
*   #### Easy innovation
    
    OCI meets you where you are on your application modernization journey, offering a full range of AI, low-code, and open source services.

## Cloud native customer stories

*   #### Streamline application development
    
    Accelerate innovation and time to market with CI/CD pipelines, serverless Functions, and managed Kubernetes. Boost performance and utilization while lowering cost.
    
    [Read about JSL’s success](/customers/jsl/)
    
*   #### Harness the value of your data
    
    Put the data you already own to work. Connect your apps to structured and unstructured data in Oracle AI Database, HeatWave MySQL, and object storage buckets.
    
    [Learn about Seismic’s approach](/customers/seismic/)
    
*   #### Infuse intelligence into your apps
    
    Plug in to powerful prebuilt AI services to breathe new capabilities and intelligence into your applications. Start using generative AI, speech, language, vision, and more.
    
    [Read what Bosch has done](/customers/bosch-oda/)
    
*   #### Train and deploy AI models
    
    Use OKE to facilitate complex AI model training on vast quantities of GPUs. Automate model deployment, increase resiliency, and scale resources based on demand.
    
    [See how CERN uses OCI](/customers/cern-openlab/)
    

*   **Visit the AI Solutions Hub**
    
    Get started today with step-by-step instructions.
    
    [See AI Solutions Hub](/artificial-intelligence/solutions/)
    
*   **OCI Kubernetes Engine (OKE) blog posts**
    
    Read product news and thought leadership.
    
    [Read Kubernetes posts](https://blogs.oracle.com/?s=kubernetes)
    
*   **Try a free OKE workshop**
    
    Get started with one of OCI's container services.
    
    [Launch workshop](https://livelabs.oracle.com/ords/r/dbpm/livelabs/livelabs-workshop-cards?clear=100&search=OKE&session=15882112021497)
    

## Everything you need to build cloud native applications

OCI cloud native services enable you to quickly design and deploy container-based applications, microservices, and more.

*   [
    
    ###### Containers, Kubernetes, and Functions
    
    ](#containers)
    
    Package, deploy, run, and scale containerized applications more efficiently—at 3X better cost performance.
    
    *   [OCI Kubernetes Engine](/cloud/cloud-native/container-engine-kubernetes/)
        
        A managed Kubernetes service with advanced security, high performance, and an option for a serverless experience with Virtual Nodes.
        
    *   [Container Instances](/cloud/cloud-native/container-instances/)
        
        A serverless compute service that enables you to run containers easily and quickly without managing any infrastructure.
        
    
    *   [Functions](/cloud/cloud-native/functions/)
        
        A serverless compute service that allows you to create, run, and scale event-driven applications without managing any infrastructure, paying only for compute time used during function execution.
        
    
    *   [Container Registry](/cloud/cloud-native/container-registry/)
        
        A registry service to securely store, manage, and share container images with a familiar Docker CLI and API interface, with built-in security scanning and image signing.
        
    
*   [
    
    ###### AI developer services to power your next innovation
    
    ](#apis)
    
    Infuse AI into new or existing applications to support new use cases and unlock new value streams.
    
    *   [Artificial Intelligence (AI)](/artificial-intelligence/)
        
        Comprehensive AI services and state-of-the-art generative AI innovations on our data platform and in our cloud applications—all on a best-in-class AI infrastructure.
        
    *   [Generative AI Service](/artificial-intelligence/generative-ai/generative-ai-service/)
        
        Fully managed service for seamlessly integrating large language models (LLMs) into a range of use cases, such as writing assistance, summarization, analysis, and chat.
        
    
    *   [Generative AI Agents](/artificial-intelligence/generative-ai/agents/)
        
        Combines the power of LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with your enterprise data, letting users query diverse enterprise knowledge bases.
        
    *   [Digital Assistant](/chatbots/)
        
        Chatbots to deliver conversational experiences via your website, mobile apps, and business applications.
        
    *   [Language](/artificial-intelligence/language/)
        
        Sophisticated text analysis at scale—including sentiment analysis, key-phrase extraction, and classification.
        
    
    *   [Speech](/artificial-intelligence/speech/)
        
        Automatic speech recognition (ASR) and highly accurate transcription of audio/video files across languages.
        
    *   [Vision](/artificial-intelligence/vision/)
        
        Computer vision to detect visual anomalies, automatically classify images, extract text from docs, and more.
        
    *   [Document Understanding](/artificial-intelligence/document-understanding/)
        
        Extracts text, tables, and other key data from document files to automate tedious business processing tasks with prebuilt AI models to fit industry-specific needs.
        
    
*   [
    
    ###### Everything you need for modern services communication
    
    ](#messaging-streaming)
    
    Create, consume, secure, and manage the lifecycle of everything required for microservices to communicate with each other.
    
    *   [API Management](/cloud/cloud-native/api-management/)
        
        A managed, high availability API frontend gateway for deploying, operating, securing, and monetizing API services.
        
    *   [Serverless APIs](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/APIGateway/Tasks/apigatewayusingfunctionsbackend.htm)
        
        OCI Functions triggered on demand to connect to APIs, eliminating the need for infrastructure operations or over-provisioning.
        
    
    *   [Events](/cloud/events-service/)
        
        CloudEvents-compatible service that tracks resource changes to trigger functions, write to streams, or send email, SMS, or other webhooks notifications.
        
    *   [Notifications](/cloud/cloud-native/notifications/)
        
        High availability, low-latency publish/subscribe service that sends alerts and messages to OCI Functions, email, SMS, and message delivery partners, including Slack, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow.
        
    
    *   [Streaming with Kafka](/cloud/streaming/)
        
        Real-time, serverless, Kafka-compatible event streaming for developers and data scientists with pay-as-you-go pricing and zero-cost data movement between cloud services.
        
    *   [Queue](/cloud/queue/)
        
        A serverless messaging service for securely autoscaling asynchronous, guaranteed message delivery; sends and receives messages using REST and STOMP endpoints.
        
    
*   [
    
    ###### From dev to production: DevOps, CI/CD, and application development
    
    ](#development)
    
    Plug in and run whatever you need with full support for open source, third-party technologies, and ecosystem tools.
    
    *   Native dev environment
        
        Development environment with option to plug in existing Dev tools or use built-in [Code repository](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/devops/using/managing_coderepo.htm), [Container Registry](/cloud/cloud-native/container-registry/), [Artifact Repository](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/artifacts/home.htm), [Code Editor](/application-development/cloud-shell/), [Cloud Shell](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/cloudshellintro.htm), and more.
        
    *   Low-code development
        
        Enables non-developers to easily extend Oracle business applications, build mobile apps, or add a GUI on top of databases via [APEX](https://apex.oracle.com/en/platform/low-code/) or [Visual Builder Studio](/application-development/visual-builder-studio/).
        
    *   [DevOps CI/CD](/cloud/cloud-native/devops-service/)
        
        Declarative serverless CI/CD pipelines to automate end-to-end delivery; includes secure deployments to private resources and options such as canary, rolling, and more.
        
    
    *   [Code Editor](/application-development/code-editor/)
        
        In-console tool designed on Eclipse Theia framework for efficient source code editing.
        
    *   Work how you like
        
        As a developer or DevOps engineer, work with OCI’s [REST APIs](/application-development/technologies/eclipse/oracle-enterprise-pack.html), [CLI](//docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/ToolsConfig.htm), [SDKs](//docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/sdks.htm), [Cloud Shell](//docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/cloudshellintro.htm), or via the [intuitive GUI](/cloud/sign-in.html).
        
    *   [Integrated ecosystem](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/devopstools_topic-DevOps_Tools_and_Plugins.htm)
        
        Connects tools already in use such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, Rancher, EFK, Spinnaker, etc. enables use of our IDE plugins for [Visual Studio](/database/technologies/developer-tools/visual-studio/), [Eclipse](/application-development/technologies/eclipse/oracle-enterprise-pack.html), and more, as well as OCI’s providers and operators for VMware Tanzu, Azure, Pulumi, and others.
        
    
    *   [Resource Manager](/cloud/cloud-native/resource-manager/)
        
        Terraform-as-a-service to automate infrastructure as code
        
    *   
    
*   [
    
    ###### Modern data solutions designed for developers
    
    ](#database-data-science-blockchain)
    
    Leverage cost-optimized and high performance databases plus data science and blockchain.
    
    *   [HeatWave MySQL](/mysql/)
        
        Elastic MySQL database service that combines transactions, analytics and in-database ML all in one; automated operations and high performance significantly faster than RDS or Snowflake at a fraction of the cost.
        
    *   [Autonomous AI Database](/autonomous-database/)
        
        Serverless, high performant Oracle AI Database service that runs all workloads, including OLTP, analytics, batch, JSON, Internet of Things (IoT), and more.
        
    
    *   [NoSQL](/database/nosql/)
        
        Predictable single-digit millisecond performance at scale, suitable for applications with dynamic I/O rate or for serverless applications; supports both schema and schemaless data models.
        
    *   [Machine Learning Services](/artificial-intelligence/machine-learning/)
        
        A full range of ML and GenAI innovations, including vector databases, fully integrated in Oracle’s data platforms, providing in-database tools and algorithms to build, manage, and deploy ML models.
        
    
    *   [Data Science](/artificial-intelligence/data-science/)
        
        End-to-end ML service enables data scientists to build, train, and manage ML models using their favorite open source frameworks and tools.
        
    *   [Blockchain](/blockchain/cloud-platform/)
        
        Based on the open source Hyperledger Fabric, Oracle’s managed service enables quick provisioning of a private, secure, preassembled blockchain network with a shared distributed ledger.
        
    
*   [
    
    ###### Java—reimagined for modern microservices
    
    ](#applications)
    
    Benefit from the best support, out-of-the-box management, and enhanced performance for modernizing Java apps.
    
    *   [High performance Java—free on OCI](/java/)
        
        At no cost for Java applications running on OCI
        
    *   [Free Java SE](/java/technologies/downloads/)
        
        All the benefits of the Java SE subscription, available for free on OCI.
        
    
    *   [Java Management Service](https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/jms/doc/getting-started-jms.html#GUID-3FC9F2D3-1680-4B32-8509-7F922335C068)
        
        Single pane of glass to manage large-scale Java environments for performance, security, and compliance.
        
    *   [Micronaut](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-oracle-cloud/snapshot/guide/) and [Helidon](https://helidon.io)
        
        Lightweight Java microservice application frameworks.
        
    
    *   [WebLogic Server for OKE](/java/weblogic/weblogic-for-oracle-cloud-infrastructure/)
        
        Java EE environment deployment on OCI, including WebLogic Server on Kubernetes.
        
    *   [Coherence](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/coherence-cloud/index.html)
        
        Enables caching for even faster performance.
        
    *   [VisualVM](https://visualvm.github.io/index.html)
        
        All-in-one Java troubleshooting tool.

## Why customers choose OCI for cloud native services

### Improve developer speed and productivity

*   **[Intermedia](/customers/intermedia/)** uses OCI Generative AI to automate time-consuming activities.
    
*   **[Wiz](/customers/wiz/)** selected OCI in part due to Oracle’s commitment to open source.
    
*   **[Impulse Logic](/cloud/technical-case-studies/impulse-logic/)** modernized their store optimization software to be cloud native.
    
*   **Inworld** chose OCI because of its AI infrastructure, OKE, and Oracle Support.
    

### Ensure reliable operations and optimal cost performance

*   **[ALEF](/cloud/technical-case-studies/alef/)** picked OCI as a cost-effective, scalable, and secure cloud-based solution.
    
*   **[8x8](/customers/8x8/)** delivers high-quality service with OCI’s flexible shapes and global regions.
    
*   **[McGraw Hill](/customers/mcgraw-hill/)** launched a multicloud data center exit using OCI services.
